entities.name: UE configuration parameter update
entities.description: Procedure for updating UE configuration parameters stored on USIM and ME via NAS signalling. Supported for PLMN and SNPN networks.

entities.name: Network-initiated downlink NAS transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by network to initiate UE configuration parameter updates.

entities.name: UE-initiated uplink NAS transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by UE to acknowledge successful reception of updated UE configuration parameters.

entities.name: USIM configuration parameters
entities.description: Configuration parameters stored on USIM that can be updated via NAS signalling.

entities.name: ME configuration parameters
entities.description: Configuration parameters stored on ME that can be updated via NAS signalling, including default configured NSSAI and disaster roaming information.

entities.name: Default configured NSSAI
entities.description: ME configuration parameter that can be updated via NAS signalling.

entities.name: Disaster roaming information
entities.description: ME configuration parameter that can be updated via NAS signalling in PLMN networks.

entities.name: Secure dynamic reconfiguration
entities.description: Property of UE configuration parameter update procedure ensuring secure and dynamic reconfiguration of UE parameters.

relations.description: UE configuration parameter update procedure uses network-initiated downlink NAS transport for initiation.
UE configuration parameter update procedure uses UE-initiated uplink NAS transport for acknowledgement.
UE configuration parameter update procedure establishes updates to USIM configuration parameters.
UE configuration parameter update procedure establishes updates to ME configuration parameters.
ME configuration parameters include default configured NSSAI.
ME configuration parameters include disaster roaming information for PLMN networks.
